hypothesis.statement: Fully replacing O with S on the γ-Li3PO4 framework lowers the Li migration barrier, with framework topology, PX4 tetrahedra and Li site connectivity held fixed. Mechanism: Li–S bonds are longer than Li–O, widening the triangular bottleneck faces Li crosses between tetrahedral sites; and S²⁻ is more polarizable than O²⁻, so the anion cage deforms around Li at the saddle point instead of resisting it.
hypothesis.rationale: Zero measurements on record; nothing here is evidence, and all numbers are pre-committed decision thresholds, not estimates. The anion-sublattice claim is the cheapest one whose failure teaches the most, because it decides where later rounds search. If sulfide lowers the barrier at fixed framework, later rounds should work within sulfide (possibly heavier chalcogenide or halide) frameworks and focus on the hull problem. If not, the soft-anion rule is wrong for these models, the barrier is set by framework topology and site connectivity, and later rounds should screen frameworks rather than anions. Comparing native γ-Li3PO4 with native β-Li3PS4 would change anion and framework together, so the decisive pair holds the γ-Li3PO4 framework fixed and swaps only the anion. Native β-Li3PS4 is added to measure the hull-energy cost of holding the framework, which is needed in round 2 either way. Values are short-timescale, few-hundred-atom quantities: a lower barrier is a statement about the computed hop, not bulk conductivity, grain-boundary transport, or synthesizability beyond hull energy.
hypothesis.prediction: Li3PS4 in the γ-Li3PO4 framework (100% O → S) shows a migration_barrier at least 0.15 eV lower than γ-Li3PO4, both computed the same way. Hull energy is not part of the claim. The held-framework sulfide is expected to sit higher above the hull than native β-Li3PS4, because the sulfide is forced into the oxide's preferred packing.
hypothesis.falsification_criterion: Dead if migration_barrier(γ-framework Li3PS4) ≥ migration_barrier(γ-Li3PO4), or if the sulfide is lower by less than 0.05 eV. A reduction between 0.05 and 0.15 eV counts as weak and unconfirmed, not support. The decisive pair is void, and not support, if either barrier is flagged OOD, if either is flagged proxy with low confidence, or if the held-framework sulfide relaxes into a different topology. Separately, if candidate 2 comes out far above the hull while β-Li3PS4 sits near it, that counts against framework-holding substitutions as a design route, whatever the barrier result.

batch_plan.strategy: Build exactly three candidates. Retrieve parent structures from the database, since the notebook contains none. (1) γ-Li3PO4, the oxide side of the controlled pair: retrieve the known orthorhombic γ-Li3PO4 structure (no Co or Ni) and compute migration_barrier and energy_above_hull. (2) Li3PS4 in the γ-Li3PO4 framework, the sulfide side of the controlled pair: take the candidate 1 structure and substitute every O site with S (100% O → S, no partial substitution). Keep the parent's space group, Wyckoff occupation and Li/P site assignments. Relax cell and positions, then confirm and report that the PS4 tetrahedra and Li site connectivity match the parent topology. Compute migration_barrier for the same Li hop type used in candidate 1 (between equivalent tetrahedral sites), and compute energy_above_hull. (3) β-Li3PS4, the native-framework reference and not part of the decisive pair: retrieve the known β-Li3PS4 structure and compute energy_above_hull and migration_barrier. It shows how far above the hull candidate 2 sits relative to the sulfide's preferred framework, and whether the native framework gives a lower barrier than the forced one. Hold fixed across candidates 1 and 2: framework topology, Li3PX4 stoichiometry, Li hop path definition, and calculation settings. Report confidence, proxy and OOD flags for every value. Do not substitute partially. Do not add aliovalent dopants this round.

body.commentary:
Approved: c-mp-13725 (Li3PO4) and c-mp-985583 (Li3PS4). Neither is approved as a decisive test of h1. The batch cannot decide h1. h1 needs γ-Li3PO4 and Li3PS4 built by full O→S substitution on that same γ framework, with topology, PS4 tetrahedra and Li connectivity held fixed. c-mp-985583 is a database retrieval of whatever relaxed native polymorph MP stores. It was not built from c-mp-13725, it is not guaranteed to share the γ topology, and nobody held its framework. h1 stays pending until the held-framework sulfide is generated from the c-mp-13725 structure file and scored under the same barrier protocol as the oxide. Reporting the c-mp-13725 vs c-mp-985583 barrier difference as a test of h1 would be the wrong comparison.

c-mp-13725: it is the oxide reference. The notebook gives no space group, so confirm from the structure file that it is γ (Pnma) and not β-Li3PO4. My recollection that mp-13725 is the Pnma entry is not evidence. If it is not γ, it cannot anchor h1 as written.

c-mp-985583: useful for the campaign objective as a real Li–P–S phase. It can serve as the native β-Li3PS4 reference for h1's secondary clause only if its structure file shows β. Otherwise it serves neither h1 role. Do not pair its barrier with c-mp-13725.

Defect mechanism: stoichiometric Li3PO4 and Li3PS4 have no intrinsic Li vacancies, so any barrier needs an introduced vacancy or interstitial/interstitialcy hop. Both barriers in the real pair must use the same mechanism, or the pair is void because it was not computed the same way. If the mechanism is not recorded, note that it is missing.

Upper bounds: a single-NEB-path barrier applies to that hop only and is an upper bound on the structure's lowest barrier. An oxide–sulfide comparison is then a comparison of two upper bounds. Record which hop was computed. Treat differences near the 0.05 and 0.15 eV thresholds as unresolved unless the hop topology matches.

MD-derived barriers: picosecond MD with an Arrhenius fit extrapolates from high temperature over short runs. Treat these as lower confidence than converged NEB and check the confidence field.

Flags: Li–P–O and Li–P–S should be in distribution. If either barrier is flagged OOD, h1's rule voids the pair. The barrier is itself a proxy for ionic conductivity. Nothing here addresses bulk conductivity, grain-boundary resistance, electrochemical window or device behaviour.

Hull: the seed strategy selected near-hull entries, so hull values on the retrieved entries will largely reproduce the database. They are only as good as the competing-phase set. The secondary clause cannot be evaluated this round because the held-framework sulfide does not exist yet. "Far above" has no numerical threshold in h1, and the Analyst must not supply one after the fact. A threshold must be stated before the held-framework number is seen.

measurement.method: DFT (GGA) band gap, Materials Project mp-13725
measurement.note: Proxy for the electrochemical stability window, which is what actually decides whether this survives contact with lithium metal. body.reasoning:
The decisive candidate does not exist. h1 is a claim about Li3PS4 built by full O→S substitution on the γ-Li3PO4 framework, with topology, PX4 tetrahedra and Li connectivity held fixed, and no structure was generated that way this round. Both the barrier clause and the hull clause depend on that structure, so neither can be applied.

Barrier clause: the oxide side has a number, c-mp-13725 at 0.326 eV, but nothing in the notebook records it as Pnma/γ. The sulfide side has no number. c-mp-985583 is a Materials Project retrieval, not derived from the c-mp-13725 structure, with no space group or topology recorded. The Skeptic's ruling is accepted: reading 0.326 − 0.274 = 0.052 eV as a test of h1 would compare two unrelated polymorphs. Even if the pairing were valid, 0.052 eV clears the 0.05 eV death threshold by 0.002 eV and falls 0.098 eV short of the predicted 0.15 eV, so the best possible reading under the Strategist's rule is 'weak and unconfirmed'. That reading is also fragile. The hops differ (2.95 Å vs 3.26 Å). The supercells differ (127-atom 2x2x2 vs 63-atom 2x1x1). The ordering flips with direction: forward the sulfide is 0.026 eV higher, reverse it is 0.052 eV lower. Each value is a single-path NEB upper bound at confidence 0.60.

Void conditions: neither barrier is flagged OOD or proxy, and both are vacancy-mediated, so the mechanism matches. The topology condition cannot be checked because the held-framework sulfide was never relaxed. The small relaxations of the retrieved structures say nothing about whether a forced γ-sulfide would hold.

Hull clause: the held-framework number does not exist. It is unconfirmed that c-mp-985583 is β; it is listed as a computed-only phase. h1 gives no numerical meaning for 'far above', and none is supplied after the fact.

What would settle h1, in order: (1) confirm c-mp-13725 is Pnma γ; (2) build Li3PS4 by full O→S substitution on that structure file; (3) relax it with MACE-MP-0 and confirm the topology survives, otherwise void the pair; (4) compute migration_barrier on the hop symmetry-equivalent to the oxide's 2.95 Å hop, at matched supercell size, reporting forward and reverse climbs; (5) compute its MACE energy_above_hull against the same Li–P–S competing-phase set used for c-mp-985583, and compare it to a 'far above' threshold written down beforehand.

Campaign note, separate from h1: c-mp-985583 holds rank 0 on the Pareto frontier at 0.274 eV and 0.0014 eV/atom, but its MP record says it has never been reported experimentally. A DFT hull distance of 0 eV/atom does not show it can be synthesized. Nothing here addresses bulk ionic conductivity, grain-boundary transport or device behaviour.
evidence: c-mp-13725 (Li3PO4): migration_barrier = 0.326 eV (MACE-MP-0, confidence 0.60), 2.95 Å vacancy hop, 127-atom supercell, forward 0.183 eV / reverse 0.326 eV. Oxide side of the pair, conditional on confirming it is γ.

c-mp-985583 (Li3PS4): migration_barrier = 0.274 eV (MACE-MP-0, confidence 0.60), 3.26 Å vacancy hop, 63-atom supercell, forward 0.209 eV / reverse 0.274 eV. Not the held-framework sulfide and cannot stand in for it.
Forward climbs are 0.183 eV (c-mp-13725) vs 0.209 eV (c-mp-985583); reverse climbs are 0.326 eV vs 0.274 eV. The sign of the difference depends on hop direction on these unmatched paths.

Relaxation: c-mp-13725 0.012 Å, 0.0015 eV/atom; c-mp-985583 0.014 Å, 0.0008 eV/atom. Both retrieved structures sit at minima of the potential; this bears on neither the held-framework topology nor h1.

c-mp-13725: MACE energy_above_hull = 0.0092 eV/atom (confidence 0.55); MP DFT energy_above_hull_dft = 0 eV/atom (confidence 0.95). Its MACE hull excluded 13 phases above 80 atoms and had 3 unconverged competitors, so the distance may be an underestimate.

c-mp-985583: MACE energy_above_hull = 0.0014 eV/atom (confidence 0.55); MP DFT energy_above_hull_dft = 0 eV/atom (confidence 0.95). MACE and DFT values are on different scales and are not compared; none addresses h1's hull clause.

Band gaps (proxy, GGA, confidence 0.60): c-mp-13725 5.818 eV, c-mp-985583 2.81 eV. Ordinal only: the oxide's gap is wider. They say nothing about the electrochemical window against Li metal or about h1.

heuristics.text: Generate any framework-held substitution explicitly from the parent structure file before scoring it. Never let a database retrieval of the same formula stand in for it.
Record space group or topology before and after relaxation for every member of a substitution pair. Void the pair automatically if the topology changes or is unrecorded.

Have the Strategist write a numeric 'far above hull' threshold, on the MACE energy_above_hull scale, before the held-framework sulfide is scored. Thresholds supplied after seeing the data are not admissible.

For any oxide–sulfide barrier comparison, compute symmetry-equivalent hops at matched supercell size and report forward and reverse climbs for both members. Here the ordering inverted between directions (0.183 vs 0.209 eV forward, 0.326 vs 0.274 eV reverse).

When a predicted effect sits within about 0.05 eV of a decision threshold on single-path NEB barriers at confidence 0.60, compute at least one additional symmetry-distinct hop per structure before calling the result.

Score synthesizability using the MP 'experimentally reported' flag alongside hull distance. Do not report a computed-only phase at 0 eV/atom DFT hull, such as c-mp-985583, as synthesizable on hull distance alone.

hypothesis.statement: On the framework of c-mp-13725 (Li3PO4), full O→S substitution lowers the vacancy-mediated Li migration barrier, with framework topology, PX4 tetrahedra and Li-site connectivity held fixed. Mechanism: Li–S bonds are longer than Li–O bonds, widening the triangular anion faces Li passes through between tetrahedral sites; and S²⁻ is more polarizable than O²⁻, so the anion cage deforms around Li at the saddle point. The claim concerns c-mp-13725's actual framework, whatever its space group; the label γ is used only if the recorded space group is Pnma.
hypothesis.rationale: h1 was inconclusive, not refuted: the decisive held-framework sulfide was never built. No claim has yet been tested on a controlled pair, so the cheapest claim whose outcome would teach the most is still h1, executed as written (two relaxations, two pairs of NEBs, one hull evaluation). The round-1 0.326 vs 0.274 eV comparison is not evidence either way: unrelated polymorphs, different hop lengths and supercell sizes, and the sign flips with hop direction. Expectation is only moderate and rests on the mechanism, not on any number in the notebook. Two ways to be wrong: the bottleneck may not widen enough to matter, or the forced sulfide may not hold the oxide topology (pair void, which itself says framework-holding is not a usable route). The hull clause carries the second lesson: a low barrier on a structure far above the hull does not serve the goal. Hull threshold written before any sulfide is scored, on the MACE energy_above_hull scale against the same Li–P–S competing-phase set used for c-mp-985583: far above means > 0.050 eV/atom, near means ≤ 0.025 eV/atom. Scale reason: c-mp-13725 is 0 eV/atom on the DFT hull but 0.0092 eV/atom on the MACE hull, so MACE carries roughly 0.01 eV/atom offset here and 0.050 is about five times that. Caveats: every barrier is a single-path NEB upper bound at confidence 0.60; nothing addresses bulk conductivity, grain-boundary transport, long-timescale stability or synthesizability beyond hull distance and the MP experimental flag; c-mp-985583 remains a computed-only phase.
hypothesis.prediction: On hop A (symmetry-equivalent to the oxide's 2.95 Å hop, matched supercell size), the held-framework sulfide's rate-limiting climb is at least 0.15 eV lower than the oxide's (oxide's current value for scale: 0.326 eV). The same direction holds on a second symmetry-distinct hop B, with a reduction of at least 0.15 eV there too.
hypothesis.falsification_criterion: Decision quantity is the rate-limiting climb on each hop (larger of forward and reverse, both reported). Dead if barrier_S(A) ≥ barrier_O(A) − 0.05 eV. Also dead if barrier_S(B) ≥ barrier_O(B). A reduction between 0.05 and 0.15 eV on hop A is weak and unconfirmed, not support. Support requires a reduction of at least 0.15 eV on both hop A and hop B. Void (not support) if the sulfide's space group after relaxation differs from c-mp-13725's, either space group is unrecorded, any P loses fourfold coordination by S, any barrier is flagged OOD, or any barrier is flagged proxy with confidence below 0.5. Hull verdict, independent of barrier verdict: if the held-framework sulfide has MACE energy_above_hull > 0.050 eV/atom while c-mp-985583 is ≤ 0.025 eV/atom, that counts against framework-holding substitution as a design route in this campaign, even if the barrier claim survives.

batch_plan.strategy: Decisive comparison is candidate 1 vs candidate 2, holding fixed framework topology, site indices, vacancy site, hop endpoints and supercell multiplicity. Candidate 1: c-mp-13725 Li3PO4 oxide parent, rescored. Load the c-mp-13725 structure file; record space group with spglib at symprec 0.1 Å before and after MACE-MP-0 relaxation. Build 2x2x2 supercell (128 atoms), create one Li vacancy (127-atom cell). Hop A: identify the 2.95 Å Li hop used in round 1; record vacancy site index and destination site index. Hop B: shortest Li–Li hop not symmetry-equivalent to hop A; record indices and length. Run NEB on both hops; report forward, reverse and rate-limiting climbs for each. Do not reuse the round-1 0.326 eV number. Candidate 2: held-framework Li3PS4, generated from the c-mp-13725 structure file by replacing 100% of O with S; do not retrieve Li3PS4 from any database. Relax with MACE-MP-0 (cell and positions). Record space group (spglib, symprec 0.1 Å) before and after relaxation and P–S coordination number for every P. If the space group changes or any P is not 4-coordinate, stop and report the pair void; run no barriers. Otherwise build the 2x2x2 supercell, remove the same vacancy site index as candidate 1, run NEB on hops A and B with the same endpoint indices as candidate 1, report forward and reverse climbs, hop lengths and rate-limiting climb, and compute MACE energy_above_hull against the same Li–P–S competing-phase set used for c-mp-985583 in round 1. Candidate 3: c-mp-985583 retrieved Li3PS4, hull reference only. Record its space group (spglib, symprec 0.1 Å) from the relaxed structure; its existing MACE energy_above_hull of 0.0014 eV/atom against the same phase set stands; no new barrier. It plays no part in the barrier verdict and is used only to evaluate the hull clause against the pre-written thresholds (far above > 0.050 eV/atom, near ≤ 0.025 eV/atom).

body.heading: Candidate generation — retrieval and perturbation
body.text:
I am proposing one edit rather than about six, because the specification admits only one new structure. Every other edit I could add would change something other than the anion on c-mp-13725's framework, and the reviewer would reject it as off-spec.

Which structures each clause needs:
(a) Barrier prediction and the hop A / hop B death clauses: barrier_O(A), barrier_O(B), barrier_S(A) and barrier_S(B). This takes two structures.
- Candidate 1 is c-mp-13725, the oxide parent. It is already in the notebook and needs no edit, but it must be rescored. Record its space group with spglib at symprec 0.1 Å before and after relaxation. Build the 2x2x2 supercell with one Li vacancy (127 atoms). Run NEB on hop A, the 2.95 Å hop, and on hop B, the shortest Li–Li hop not symmetry-equivalent to A. Record the vacancy and endpoint indices and report forward and reverse climbs. Do not reuse the round-1 value of 0.326 eV.
- Candidate 2 is the held-framework sulfide from the edit above. It uses the same vacancy index, the same endpoint indices and the same 2x2x2 supercell multiplicity as candidate 1.
(b) Void conditions: space group before and after relaxation for both members, P–S coordination for every P, and the OOD and proxy flags. All of these are recorded on candidates 1 and 2.
(c) Hull clause: MACE energy_above_hull for candidate 2 and for c-mp-985583.
- Candidate 3 is c-mp-985583. It is already measured at 0.0014 eV/atom against the same Li–P–S phase set, so it needs no edit and no new barrier. Only its space group should be recorded from the relaxed structure. It is a hull reference only and stays out of the barrier verdict.

The batch of 3 is therefore: candidate 1, the rescored parent; candidate 2, this edit; and candidate 3, the existing reference.

Why no further edits:
- O→Se on the same framework, Li3PO4→Li3PS4 analogues with Ge or Si on the P site, and partial O/S fractions would each fail rule 2 or the end-member requirement. They also cannot sit on either side of the stated comparison.
- Changing the cation, as Li4P2O7 did, was already vetoed as off-spec in round 1.

Standing orders honoured:
- The sulfide is built from the parent file, not retrieved.
- Topology is recorded before and after relaxation for both members, and the pair is voided otherwise.
- The hull threshold (above 0.050 eV/atom far, 0.025 eV/atom or below near) was written before scoring.
- Forward and reverse climbs are reported at matched supercell size.
- A second, symmetry-distinct hop is included.
- c-mp-985583 remains flagged as computed-only for synthesizability. Applied 1 edit(s) to retrieved parent structures with ASE; the parent and the exact operation are recorded on each candidate's provenance.

body.commentary:
c-h2-1 approved, no vetoes. c-h2-1 is Li3PS4 made by substituting all 8 O sites of c-mp-13725 with S, which is the structure h1 lacked. Not a duplicate: the oxide NEB supercell was 127 atoms in 2x2x2 (128 sites with one vacancy), so the parent cell has 16 atoms, consistent with 8 O sites. c-h2-1 therefore inherits a 16-atom cell, whereas c-mp-985583's 63-atom 2x1x1 supercell implies 32 atoms per cell. The standing order forbids a database Li3PS4 standing in for the derived structure, and conversely this is not a re-scoring of c-mp-985583. Provenance is acceptable: it is derived from the parent structure file per standing order 1. The materials_project:? tag only means no MP ID, so no MP record, flag or band gap may be attached to it. Chemistry is sound: PS4 3- with P(V), Li(I), S(-II) is charge-balanced, and P is fourfold coordinated at least before relaxation. No Co or Ni. Not vetoed unsynthesizable: a high hull distance is what h2's pre-registered hull clause measures, and vetoing in advance would replace a measurement with a guess. Not vetoed OOD: Li-P-S bonding is well represented in MACE-MP-0 training data, and the relaxed endpoint should be in-distribution if the framework holds.

For the Strategist, register now: c-mp-13725's space group is still unrecorded. A 16-atom cell is Z=2, but Pnma gamma-Li3PO4 has Z=4 (32 atoms), so the parent is not the Pnma gamma structure. I am not assigning a space group; that needs symmetry analysis. The gamma label in h1 was probably wrong, and h2's 'whatever its space group' wording was right. Record the space group for c-mp-13725 and for c-h2-1 before and after relaxation, with a symmetry tolerance written beforehand. If either is unrecorded at analysis, the pair is void.

The batch must also contain the following, or h2 cannot be decided. (1) An oxide hop-B NEB on a symmetry-distinct hop of c-mp-13725. Only hop A (0.326 eV) exists; without hop B that clause is insufficient data and the most h2 can return is weak and unconfirmed. (2) A full variable-cell relaxation of c-h2-1. The start geometry has oxide-length P-S/Li-S distances and is heavily compressed, so a fixed-cell relaxation is meaningless. A declared isotropic rescale beforehand is acceptable. If the space group changes or any P loses fourfold S coordination, the pair is void, and that should be reported as a finding that the framework does not hold under MACE-MP-0. State the P-S cutoff before inspecting the structure. (3) Hop A chosen by carried-through site labels, not distance. The oxide hop is 2.95 A between inequivalent sites with 0.143 eV endpoint asymmetry. Use the same 2x2x2 supercell (127 atoms with vacancy) and report forward and reverse climbs. (4) A MACE hull against c-mp-985583's competing-phase set (89 phases, 5 excluded for size), not the oxide's set.

Decision numbers on hop A versus the oxide's 0.326 eV: >=0.276 eV is dead; 0.176-0.276 eV is weak and unconfirmed; <=0.176 eV together with a >=0.15 eV reduction on hop B is support. Never compare a c-h2-1 barrier with c-mp-985583's 0.274 eV: different structures, hops (3.26 vs 2.95 A) and supercells. Hull: c-mp-985583 is 0.0014 eV/atom (<=0.025), so the clause reduces to whether c-h2-1's MACE energy_above_hull is >0.050 eV/atom. That threshold was pre-written and is admissible.

Upper bounds: every migration_barrier is a single-path NEB at confidence 0.60, an upper bound on the structure's lowest barrier. If any result lands within 0.05 eV of 0.176 or 0.276, compute another symmetry-distinct hop. Two hops per structure is the minimum, not a margin.

Hull caveats point in opposite directions. Excluding phases above 80 atoms can make a hull distance an underestimate. Unconverged competing phases push the hull up, making candidates look more stable than they are. c-mp-13725's 0.0092 eV/atom carries both (13 excluded, 3 unconverged). Check c-h2-1's run for unconverged phases before reading a value near 0.050. Never compare MACE energy_above_hull with MP energy_above_hull_dft.

Expect a large relaxation_drop for c-h2-1, unlike the 0.0008-0.0015 eV/atom of the retrieved structures. That is expected from oxide geometry and is not by itself evidence of instability; the topology check decides.

Extrapolation: the early relaxation trajectory from the compressed sulfide is far from training data, though the endpoint should not be. NEB saddles in a hypothetical framework are the least anchored quantities in this batch. Any OOD-flagged barrier voids the pair.

Proxies: c-h2-1 has no band gap. Do not borrow 2.81 eV (c-mp-985583) or 5.818 eV (c-mp-13725); both are GGA proxies for the stability window anyway.

Synthesizability: c-h2-1 is generated, with no experimental record. No hull value can be reported as synthesizable, even on the Pareto frontier; it must be labelled computed-only and never reported experimentally. Nothing here speaks to bulk conductivity, grain boundaries or device behaviour.

The input relaxed downhill by 6.097 eV/atom, more than the 0.05 eV/atom typical of an already-equilibrated cell — it started far from any structure in MACE-MP-0's relaxation-trajectory training set.

measurement.note: How far the input sat above the potential's nearest minimum. Residual force 0.032 eV/A.

measurement.method: convex hull of the Li-P-S system rebuilt from MACE-MP-0 energies (89 Materials Project phases re-relaxed with MACE at fmax 0.05 eV/A); NOT a DFT hull distance
measurement.note: The candidate and all 89 competing phases are on one MACE energy scale, so this is comparable across candidates but is not MP's DFT hull distance and the two must not be compared directly. 5 phase(s) larger than 80 atoms were excluded as too costly to relax; if one of those was a hull vertex this distance is an underestimate.

measurement.method: CI-NEB, 9 images, vacancy-mediated Li hop, MACE-MP-0 (medium), fmax 0.05 eV/A
measurement.note: Rate-limiting uphill climb along a 2.15 A vacancy-mediated Li hop in a 127-atom 2x2x2 supercell. Forward 428968180.266 eV / reverse 430674474.375 eV; endpoint asymmetry 439843.336 eV (inequivalent sites, so the two directions differ). Scored as the largest climb from any preceding minimum rather than peak-minus-endpoint, because migration often passes through a metastable interstitial that would otherwise hide the real barrier. The band did NOT converge to fmax 0.05 eV/A in 400 steps, so this is whatever the band had reached and not a located saddle point: the true barrier may be either higher or lower. Flagged out-of-distribution. Hard OOD: P-S contact of 1.54 A is 0.73x the covalent-radius sum (2.12 A), short of the 0.85x seen in relaxed structures — strained, though still in a plausible range. The NEB did not converge in 400 steps, so the reported barrier is whatever the band had reached, not a located saddle point. Somewhere along the path the migrating ion is squeezed to 0.26x the covalent-radius sum of its closest neighbour, inside the 0.70x floor — that image's energy is not physical.

body.reasoning: The barrier pair is void under h2's own pre-registered void conditions, and four of them are triggered independently. (1) The only sulfide barrier, c-h2-1 hop A at 4.307e+08 eV, is flagged OOD. Its band did not converge in 400 steps. One image squeezes Li to 0.26x the covalent-radius sum, inside the 0.70x floor. Its endpoint asymmetry is 439843.336 eV, so the endpoints themselves are broken. It carries zero evidential weight in either direction, and reading it against the 0.276 eV death line would treat a failed calculation as a measurement. (2) No space group is recorded for c-mp-13725 or c-h2-1, before or after relaxation. (3) No post-relaxation P–S coordination count exists, and no P–S cutoff was stated beforehand. A 1.54 Å P–S contact at 0.73x the covalent-radius sum persisted into the NEB structure. (4) The c-h2-1 hop is 2.15 Å, with no carried-through site labels, so it is not shown to be equivalent to the oxide's 2.95 Å hop. Hop B is insufficient data on both sides: no oxide hop-B NEB on c-mp-13725 and no sulfide hop-B NEB on c-h2-1. The hull numbers cross the pre-written threshold: c-mp-985583 is at 0.0014 eV/atom (≤0.025) and c-h2-1 at 0.8394 eV/atom (>0.050). The clause still cannot be applied. c-h2-1's topology was never checked after a 6.097 eV/atom relaxation drop, so it is not shown to be the held-framework sulfide. The relaxation protocol (variable-cell or isotropic rescale) is unrecorded, and the value is OOD at confidence 0.55. The 0.8394 eV/atom describes this specific relaxed structure only. That structure is not a candidate and does not enter the Pareto frontier. Settling h2 requires, in order: the parent space group with a stated tolerance; an oxide hop-B NEB; a sulfide re-relaxation with a declared isotropic pre-expansion and full variable-cell relaxation, recording volume, space group and P–S coordination against a pre-stated cutoff; then gated NEBs on the matched 127-atom 2x2x2 supercell, with the hop chosen by site labels and forward and reverse climbs reported. The Pareto frontier is unchanged. c-mp-985583 remains a computed-only phase, never reported experimentally, and is not shown synthesizable.
evidence: c-h2-1 migration_barrier = 4.307e+08 eV (conf 0.60, OOD): 2.15 Å hop, forward 428968180.266 eV, reverse 430674474.375 eV, endpoint asymmetry 439843.336 eV; band unconverged after 400 steps, one image at 0.26x covalent sum. Void.

c-h2-1 energy_above_hull = 0.8394 eV/atom (conf 0.55, OOD): exceeds the pre-registered 0.050 eV/atom line, but topology and relaxation protocol are unrecorded, so it is not admissible against the route.
c-h2-1 energy_per_atom = -3.547 eV/atom (conf 0.75, OOD): 0.839 eV/atom above c-mp-985583's -4.386 eV/atom at the same composition on the same scale, consistent with the hull value.
c-h2-1 relaxation_drop = 6.097 eV/atom (conf 0.75, OOD): residual force 0.032 eV/Å; framework retention unverified.
c-h2-1 relaxation_displacement = 1.254 Å (conf 0.75, OOD): RMS 0.920 Å; no topology check recorded.
c-mp-13725 migration_barrier = 0.326 eV (conf 0.60): forward 0.183 eV, reverse 0.326 eV, 2.95 Å hop; the only valid barrier in the pair; hop B absent.
c-mp-985583 energy_above_hull = 0.0014 eV/atom (conf 0.55): meets the ≤0.025 eV/atom side of the hull clause.

heuristics.text: Treat any NEB as no measurement if its band did not converge, if any image puts the migrating ion below 0.70x the covalent-radius sum of a neighbour, or if endpoint asymmetry exceeds 1 eV. Never pass such a value to a falsification criterion or to Pareto scoring. Report it as a failed calculation, not a barrier.

Do not run an NEB on a substituted structure until it passes a recorded gate: space group recorded before and after relaxation, every P fourfold-coordinated by the new anion within a cutoff stated in advance, and no contact below 0.85x the covalent-radius sum. If the gate fails, stop and report the relaxation outcome as the result.

For substitution by a larger anion, apply a declared isotropic pre-expansion and run a full variable-cell relaxation. Record the cell volume before and after, and the protocol used. Void any hull or barrier comparison where the protocol is unrecorded.

Complete the parent-side measurements of a substitution pair, meaning the parent space group and every oxide hop the criterion names, before spending compute on the derived structure. These are in-distribution and cheap, and their absence voids the pair regardless of what the derived structure does.

Apply a hull clause about a 'held-framework' structure only after the topology check on that structure has passed. A hull distance on an unverified relaxation describes that relaxation, not the design route.

body.reasoning: No compute rounds remain, so the campaign converges. This is not because the frontier stabilised. The O→S substitution question on the c-mp-13725 framework was never actually tested. In h1 the held-framework sulfide was never built. In h2 it was built (c-h2-1) but failed every gate: a 6.097 eV/atom relaxation drop, a persistent 1.54 Å P–S contact (0.73x covalent-radius sum), no space group or P–S coordination recorded, and an unconverged NEB returning 4.307e+08 eV with one image at 0.26x. The campaign is entitled to no statement about the claim, for or against. The hull clause numbers cross the threshold (c-h2-1 at 0.8394 eV/atom vs 0.050, c-mp-985583 at 0.0014 vs 0.025), but c-h2-1 was never shown to be the held-framework structure, so the clause describes one failed relaxation, not the design route. The line produced protocol, not a result. A third attempt would need, in order: the parent space group with a stated tolerance, an oxide hop-B NEB, a gated sulfide variable-cell relaxation, and matched 127-atom NEBs selected by site label. This goes into the proposal as unfinished work. The closing proposal has two database retrievals, neither designed by the campaign. c-mp-985583 (rank 0): migration_barrier 0.274 eV (3.26 Å hop, 63-atom 2x1x1, conf 0.60, forward 0.209 / reverse 0.274 eV), MACE energy_above_hull 0.0014 eV/atom (conf 0.55), DFT hull 0 eV/atom, computed-only and never reported experimentally, so not shown synthesizable; space group unrecorded; band_gap 2.81 eV (proxy). c-mp-13725: 0.326 eV (2.95 Å hop, 127-atom 2x2x2, conf 0.60, forward 0.183 / reverse 0.326 eV), MACE hull 0.0092 eV/atom, DFT hull 0 eV/atom, experimentally reported; band_gap 5.818 eV (proxy). Neither gap between them is resolvable. The 0.052 eV barrier difference compares different hops and supercells, single path each, and the ordering flips with direction. The 0.0078 eV/atom MACE hull difference is at confidence 0.55. The honest framing is a trade-off: a lower nominal barrier with no experimental report, against an experimentally reported phase at a nominally higher barrier. Both are Co/Ni-free. c-h2-1 does not enter the frontier, and c-mp-28450 stays vetoed on relevance. Left for the lab: whether c-mp-985583 can be synthesized, measured Li conductivity for either candidate, and the electrochemical stability window. Left for compute, out of budget: space groups for both candidates, additional symmetry-distinct hops, and matched supercells. Outside these models entirely: bulk conductivity, grain-boundary transport and device behaviour.

proposal.title: Closing proposal: Low-barrier Li solid electrolyte, no Co/Ni
proposal.summary:
Refutations: none. The campaign tested two hypotheses, and neither was refuted or supported. h1 (round 1) was void because the held-framework sulfide it was about was never built. h2 (round 2) was void under four of its own pre-registered conditions. (1) The only sulfide barrier, c-h2-1 at 4.307e+08 eV, came from a non-converged band, with one image squeezing Li to 0.26x the covalent-radius sum and an endpoint asymmetry of 439843 eV; it is a failed calculation, not a barrier. (2) No space group was recorded for either structure. (3) No P–S coordination check was run. (4) The sulfide hop (2.15 Å) was not shown to be equivalent to the oxide hop (2.95 Å). Whether full O→S substitution on the c-mp-13725 framework lowers the Li barrier remains open in both directions. The c-h2-1 hull value of 0.8394 eV/atom (OOD, confidence 0.55) describes one unverified relaxation after a 6.097 eV/atom drop and does not count against the route.

Established, all in-distribution from retrieved structures. c-mp-13725 (Li3PO4): relaxation drop 0.0015 eV/atom, RMS displacement 0.008 Å, MACE energy +0.015 eV/atom vs MP GGA, MP DFT hull 0 eV/atom (conf 0.95), MACE energy_above_hull 0.0092 eV/atom (conf 0.55), barrier 0.326 eV (conf 0.60). c-mp-985583 (Li3PS4): drop 0.0008 eV/atom, RMS 0.009 Å, +0.006 eV/atom vs MP GGA, DFT hull 0 eV/atom, MACE hull 0.0014 eV/atom, barrier 0.274 eV. Both are near-minima on the potential, and neither contains Co or Ni.

Not established: c-mp-985583 holds rank 0, but its dominance over c-mp-13725 sits inside the noise on both axes. On barrier, the gap is 0.052 eV, which clears the 0.05 eV resolution line by 0.002 eV. Each value is single-path at conf 0.60, the supercells differ (127 vs 63 atoms), the hops differ (2.95 vs 3.26 Å), and the ordering inverts with direction (forward 0.209 vs 0.183 eV; reverse 0.274 vs 0.326 eV). On hull, the gap is 0.0078 eV/atom on the MACE scale at conf 0.55, and both phases are at 0 eV/atom on the DFT hull. On synthesizability, the evidence favours the oxide: c-mp-985583 is computed-only and has never been reported experimentally, while c-mp-13725 is experimentally reported. The c-mp-985583 space group was never recorded.

Recommendation: c-mp-985583 is the primary target because it is the only frontier member. c-mp-13725 serves as the matched experimental control. c-h2-1 is not a candidate, and c-mp-28450 was vetoed and has no measurements.
synthesis_route: 0. Pre-synthesis record (computational, mandatory). Download the MP structure files for mp-985583 and mp-13725. Record each space group with spglib at symprec = 0.01 Å. Simulate Cu Kα powder patterns for both. Compare the mp-985583 pattern with the experimentally reported Li3PS4 polymorphs and record whether it coincides with any of them. If it does, write down that the MP computed-only flag is in question before synthesis begins. All sulfide handling is in an Ar glovebox (O2 and H2O below 0.1 ppm), because these materials evolve H2S on contact with moisture.
1. Weigh Li2S (≥99.9%) and P2S5 (≥99%) at a 3:1 molar ratio. For a 1.000 g batch: 0.3828 g Li2S and 0.6172 g P2S5 (molar masses 45.95 and 222.27 g/mol). Prepare three 1 g batches.

2. Mechanochemical route. Load each batch into a 45 mL ZrO2 jar with ZrO2 balls at a 30:1 ball-to-powder mass ratio, sealed under Ar. Planetary mill at 500 rpm for 20 cycles of 30 min milling plus 15 min rest (10 h milling in total). Recover the powder in the glovebox.

3. Anneal series for polymorph mapping. Split the milled powder into five aliquots, each sealed in an evacuated (<10⁻³ mbar), carbon-coated quartz ampoule. Anneal at 200, 250, 300, 400 and 500 °C for 2 h each, ramping at 2 °C/min, then furnace-cool.

4. Independent solvent route. Stir 3:1 Li2S:P2S5 (1 g total) in 20 mL anhydrous THF (≤10 ppm H2O) at room temperature for 24 h. Dry under dynamic vacuum at 80 °C for 12 h, then heat at 140 °C for 2 h under vacuum to remove co-crystallized THF.

5. Li3PO4 control (c-mp-13725). Mix Li2CO3 and NH4H2PO4 at a 1.5:1 molar ratio (1.1084 g Li2CO3 and 1.1503 g NH4H2PO4, giving about 1.16 g Li3PO4). Grind in an agate mortar for 20 min. Calcine in an alumina crucible in air at 300 °C for 4 h, regrind, then fire at 800 °C for 12 h.

6. Pellets. Sulfide: cold-press 150 mg into a 10 mm PEEK die at 360 MPa with stainless-steel plungers as blocking electrodes, and record geometric density. Oxide: uniaxially press, sinter at 900 °C for 6 h, record relative density, and sputter Au on both faces. Pack NMR rotors from the same powder batches, sealed in the glovebox.
validation_protocol: V1. PXRD with Rietveld refinement, in an airtight dome holder, on every product from steps 3–5. Refine the sulfide against the mp-985583 structure and the known Li3PS4 polymorphs, reporting weight fractions and the refined space group. Refine Li3PO4 against mp-13725. Shows whether the frontier candidate can be made at all, and by which route.

V2. ³¹P MAS NMR, with Raman as a cross-check, to quantify the fraction of P in isolated PS4³⁻ units versus P2S7⁴⁻ and P2S6⁴⁻. Confirms isolated PS4 tetrahedra and catches amorphous by-products that Rietveld can miss.

V3. Variable-temperature ⁷Li NMR T1 and T1ρ from −100 °C to +150 °C on both compounds, same spectrometer and field. Extract Ea from the low-temperature flank of the relaxation-rate peak. This is the primary test of 0.274 eV and 0.326 eV and of their ordering.

V4. Variable-temperature EIS on blocking-electrode pellets, −20 to 80 °C in 10 °C steps, 7 MHz–1 Hz. Fit bulk and grain-boundary arcs separately where they resolve, and report bulk and total Ea. Not directly comparable to an NEB barrier; tests only whether the ordering survives at long range.

V5. On a phase-pure mp-985583 product, if one exists: DSC to 550 °C at 10 °C/min under Ar, plus VT-PXRD with a 12 h isothermal hold at that product's formation temperature. Shows whether the phase persists once made.

V6. Linear sweep voltammetry, cell Li | In–Li | electrolyte | electrolyte–carbon composite (70:30 wt) | stainless steel, OCV to 5 V vs Li/Li⁺ at 0.1 mV/s. Onset defined as current density >10 µA/cm². Tests only the ordinal band-gap reading (5.818 eV oxide vs 2.81 eV sulfide); no voltage prediction is made.
falsification_criteria: All thresholds below are written before any lab data exist.

F1 (synthesizability). Refuted if no product from the five anneal temperatures or the solvent route refines in the mp-985583 structure at ≥50 wt% (V1). The candidate is then withdrawn. If step 0 shows the mp-985583 pattern is indistinguishable from a known polymorph, F1 becomes a phase-match test against that polymorph, and the finding is recorded as an error in the MP flag.

F2 (sulfide absolute barrier). Applies to a sample with ≥90 wt% mp-985583 phase (V1) and ≥90% of P in isolated PS4³⁻ (V2). Refuted if the ⁷Li NMR Ea (V3) exceeds 0.374 eV, i.e. 0.274 eV plus a declared 0.10 eV tolerance. A measured Ea below 0.174 eV does not refute the goal, but it shows the computed hop is not rate-limiting and leaves 0.274 eV unvalidated.
F3 (oxide control). Refuted if the ⁷Li NMR Ea of phase-pure (≥90 wt%) mp-13725 Li3PO4 lies outside 0.226–0.426 eV. If F3 fails, F2 and F4 lose their footing whatever their outcome.

F4 (ordering, from V3). Ea(sulfide) ≥ Ea(oxide): the barrier axis of the Pareto ranking is refuted. Sulfide lower by less than 0.05 eV: unresolved, not confirmation. Sulfide lower by ≥0.05 eV: weak confirmation only.
F5 (long-range ordering). If the bulk EIS Ea (V4) of the sulfide is ≥ that of the oxide, the assumption that single-hop ordering carries through to long-range transport fails for this pair.

F6 (phase persistence). If more than 20 wt% of a phase-pure mp-985583 product converts to another phase during the 12 h hold (V5), the claim that 'close to the hull' means a usable phase fails for this candidate.
F7 (band-gap proxy). If the oxidative onset of Li3PS4 is at or above that of Li3PO4 (V6), the ordinal reading of band gap as an electrochemical window proxy is refuted.
caveats: Capability boundary. The models are MACE-MP-0 relaxations and NEBs on 63–127 atom cells over picoseconds. They say nothing about bulk ionic conductivity, bulk mechanical properties or pressability, long-timescale kinetics, degradation or phase transformation, grain-boundary or microstructural transport, interfacial reactions with Li metal or cathodes, moisture or air stability (including H2S evolution), device performance, cost, or manufacturability. V4–V6 have no computed prediction behind them beyond an ordering.
Proxy: band gap for the electrochemical window. Values are 2.81 and 5.818 eV, GGA, confidence 0.60, usable ordinally only.

Proxy: single-path vacancy-hop NEB for ionic transport, at confidence 0.60. It is not a percolation-limited long-range barrier and includes no carrier-formation energy. The two barriers come from unmatched supercells (127 vs 63 atoms) and unmatched hops (2.95 vs 3.26 Å), and their ordering inverts between forward and reverse directions.

Proxy: hull distance for synthesizability. A 0 eV/atom DFT hull is a 0 K statement about one structure and does not show the phase is reachable or persistent. c-mp-985583's computed-only status already illustrates this.

Hull-scale limits. MACE energy_above_hull (confidence 0.55) and MP DFT energy_above_hull_dft are different quantities on different scales and were not compared value-for-value. The MACE hulls excluded large competing phases (13 for c-mp-13725 and 5 for c-mp-985583, all above 80 atoms) and used 3 unconverged competing phases for c-mp-13725, so both hull values may be underestimates.

OOD. Every c-h2-1 measurement is OOD: the 6.097 eV/atom relaxation drop, the 1.254 Å displacement, the 1.54 Å P–S contact at 0.73x the covalent-radius sum, the 0.8394 eV/atom hull value, and the 4.307e+08 eV NEB (a failed calculation, not a measurement). None of these enters any recommendation or criterion.

Not separated by the measurements. Whether c-mp-985583 is a known Li3PS4 polymorph or an unreported one, and whether c-mp-13725 is γ (Pnma): no space group was recorded for either. Whether the 0.052 eV barrier difference is chemistry or an artefact of supercell, hop and direction. Whether O→S substitution on the Li3PO4 framework helps or hurts.

That last question stays open. Closing it requires the computational sequence from h2's verdict, which no lab step replaces: (1) record the parent space group; (2) compute the oxide hop-B NEB; (3) re-relax the sulfide with a declared isotropic pre-expansion and full variable-cell relaxation, recording volume, space group and P–S coordination against a pre-stated cutoff; (4) run gated NEBs on the matched 127-atom 2x2x2 supercell, choosing the hop by site labels and reporting forward and reverse climbs.
